name: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders with a shimmer synced across the whole page (or a pulse), text, heading, avatar, media and button shapes, and a blurred cross-fade reveal into the loaded content driven by aria-busy.

data-shape.label: Shape
data-shape.help: The kind of content the placeholder stands for

data-variant.label: Motion
data-variant.help: A gentle pulse, or no motion at all

aria-busy.label: Loading
aria-busy.help: Yes shows the placeholders, No shows the real content

useWhen: Content is loading and its layout is known, so placeholders can prevent layout shift
Lists, cards or profiles are fetched asynchronously and should reveal with a cross-fade once ready
Many placeholders appear at once and need one synchronized shimmer instead of competing waves

avoidWhen.when: Placeholders should visibly morph into the real content rather than simply fade
The loading area has no predictable shape, like a button action or a small inline wait
The request finished and returned nothing; show a real empty state instead

classes.name: mv-skeleton
classes.description: Loading block (any width/height, 1rem tall by default).

classes.name: mv-skeleton-text
classes.description: Stack of .mv-skeleton lines; the last one is shorter.

classes.name: mv-skeleton-reveal
classes.description: Stacks [data-skeleton] and [data-content]; aria-busy="true" shows the skeleton, "false" reveals the content with a fade + blur.

attributes.name: data-shape
attributes.type: text | heading | circle | square | button | media

attributes.name: data-skeleton="pulse"
attributes.description: Switches every descendant skeleton to pulse.

cssVars.name: --mv-skeleton-base
cssVars.description: Block color (default: text at 8%, adapts to the background).

cssVars.name: --mv-skeleton-size
cssVars.description: Size of the circle / square shapes.

a11y: Skeletons are decorative: set aria-hidden="true" on their container, and aria-busy="true" (+ aria-live="polite") on the loading region. The shimmer is synced (background-attachment: fixed) to avoid the flicker of multiple waves. Reduced motion: shimmer and pulse stop, the reveal is instant.
